messages.author: d65f5725499ff761
messages.subject: HDOM and Moran eigen vectors
parts:
Dear all,

I'm wondering if any one knows of any papers using HDOM that include Moran Eigen vectors in psi, gamma, epsilon or detection.

Thank you in advance.

Saâd Hanane, PhD
Service d'Ecologie, de Biodiversité et de Conservation des Sols
Centre de Recherche Forestière
Chariae Omar Ibn Al Khattab, BP 763, Rabat-Agdal/Maroc.

messages.author: 3205880b9759c04c
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] HDOM and Moran eigen vectors
parts:
Although not explicitly Moran Eigenvalues, Bled et al. (Ecology & Evolution) included spatial autocorrelation in theri DOM. Perhaps it is useful.

Orlando Acevedo-Charry MSc
PhD Candidate - Interdisciplinary Ecology
School of Natural Resource and Environment & 
Wildlife Ecology and Conservation
QuantitativeEcologyLab - Ordway Lab of Ecosystem Conservation
University of Florida
